subject: SI-embedded pilot credit disbursement / escrow release
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@stackbridge.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: CloudForge Billing <ops@cloudforge.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: release partner credits from escrow for SI-embedded pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for helping stand up the SI-embedded pilot with StackBridge. We’re ready to move from dev to a small closed beta with one of our anchor customers (Bellwether Health). To avoid friction in the first week, CloudForge has agreed to fund the initial platform usage via the partner escrow we set up during onboarding.

Can Redwood release the agreed-upon promo credits (50,000 platform credits ~ estimated $9,800) from escrow to the CloudForge-managed marketplace allocation so the SI can provision the pilot account?

Attached: SOW_SI_Pilot_v2.pdf (signed by StackBridge) and pilot-usage-forecast.csv (expected token profile by day).

Key ask: release credits by EOD Monday so the SI can onboard Bellwether on Tuesday.

If you need any additional PO / billing contact, loop ops@cloudforge.com.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Partnerships, StackBridge
[Attachment: SOW_SI_Pilot_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: pilot-usage-forecast.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@stackbridge.io>, CloudForge Billing <ops@cloudforge.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: release partner credits from escrow for SI-embedded pilot

Kimberly / Jonas — quick ask. StackBridge has submitted the signed SOW and forecast; they request a release of 50k platform credits from the partner escrow tied to DF-4491.

Playback: the credits were authorized during the accelerator cofund approval (see deal record). CloudForge will manage billing to the SI; Redwood needs to move the credits from the escrow ledger to the marketplace entitlement so they can provision.

Please confirm:
- Legal/billing OK with the SOW as-is?
- Ledger transfer note (escrow -> partner_entitlement/cloudforge/DF-4491) — is accounting OK to process today?
- Any caps or usage guardrails we should apply on the entitlement (we typically set a 30-day usage window and rate limit to avoid burst overage).

I’ve attached the signed SOW and the partner release template for accounting to fill out. If approved, I’ll finalize the ledger transfer request and confirm with Aisha.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_SI_Pilot_v2.pdf (pdf)]

Marissa — I reviewed the SOW and the forecast. Legal has no redlines on the SOW as submitted. Finance confirms the escrow balance for DF-4491 covers the requested 50,000 credits.

A few operational notes before release: 
- Ledger transfer will be recorded as: DF-4491 / partner_credit_release / 50,000 credits.
- We’ll set entitlement window to 30 days from activation and an enforced steady-rate throttle (2,500 credits/day) to prevent immediate exhaustion. CloudForge can request an increase if usage proves lower-latency/bursty.
- Need CloudForge’s billing contact to sign the escrow release spreadsheet (I attached a pre-filled sheet).

I’m marking this APPROVED from finance/legal. Jonas — can you queue the transfer and post the ledger entry?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Partner Finance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: escrow_release_request.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: release partner credits from escrow for SI-embedded pilot

Thanks all — completing the transfer now. 

Summary of actions taken: 
- Ledger entry DF-4491 created: partner_credit_release / 50,000 credits -> partner_entitlement/cloudforge/DF-4491.
- Entitlement created with a 30-day window and 2,500 credits/day throttle.
- CloudForge ops (ops@cloudforge.com) will receive an activation email in ~10 minutes with provisioning instructions plus the redemption token.

Aisha — please confirm receipt once the SI provisions Bellwether and we’ll monitor usage for the first 72 hours. If they hit the throttle and need a bump, have them send the usage logs to partners@redwood.com with the request ID DF-4491-INC.

Jonas Weber
Partner Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ledger-posting-confirmation.txt (text)]
